newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-LIEGE CAPTAIN HAS BAN CUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIEGE CAPTAIN HAS BAN CUT.

text.p: Standard Liege captain Guy Hellers had a seven game suspension for insulting a referee reduced to five by the UEFA Board of Appeals on Thursday.
During an Intertoto Cup match against Karlsruhe on August 20, Hellers was sent off after he verbally assaulted the referee and then urged his team mates to protest.
A 10,000 Swiss franc ($7,840) fine handed to Liege officials for improper conduct after the match was halved.
